Call with Ridgeline Dermatology Associates — Northern Virginia / DC metro.
Direct client, no agency involved. Flight is September through November.

They think in reach, not budget. Sarah was explicit: "I don't want to start
from a dollar figure, I want to know what share of the audience we can
actually get in front of." So she wants two versions to compare — one
reaching 20% of the available audience, one at 40% — and she'll pick based
on what the reach buys her.

I pulled the avails before the call. Three segments, all monthly numbers
straight out of the system:

  - Home services / home improvement intenders — about 1,000,000 a month
  - Homeowners — 600,000 a month
  - Households at $100K+ income — 400,000 a month

We agreed $30 CPM across the streaming, she pushed and I held there.

On top of the streaming she wants retargeting running the whole time
(display is fine), and she asked specifically about NFL — regular season,
not playoffs, she was clear about that. Standard rate on the NFL inventory.

Washington DC market. Monthly breakout on the plan.
